html: Corrections after an external technical review, each one reproduced before it was fixed. The reference validator did not assert format, so any string passed where a date was declared; it now asserts every format and refuses to run rather than report a pass it cannot stand behind. An allOf member said end dates must not precede start dates and enforced no ordering; date ordering within a record is now the named rules C1 and C2 at Level 1, implemented in the validator, because JSON Schema cannot compare two fields of an instance. A direct-identifier member duplicated additionalProperties: false and claimed to forbid identifiers "anywhere", which was untrue of values; the privacy profile now separates what is enforced from what is a producer obligation. value on AggregateReport was unconditionally required while section 9 required a producer below a floor to suppress and not emit it, so no conformant suppressed report could exist; corrected with an erratum. Level 3 now states that no tool in the repository verifies it, and why parts of it cannot be verified from a payload at all. Full detail in CHANGELOG.md.
